verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an email inbox platform, so bulk triage of conversations is a fair question. The evidence documents only per-thread labels for tracking conversation state, which is an adjacent feature. Nothing shows multi-select or batch archive, label, or mark-done actions in the console, API, CLI, or MCP tools.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke
